budget.bound: Remaining original allowance only: 2 P + 4 F invocations, at most 420000 tokens each. The original full $189 reserve is retained; no additional model requests for already-returned airfoil plans. Three maximum-size requests still fit 417984 tokens. No retry or fallback.

data_audit.airfoil_group_definition: four non-frequency feature values; all frequencies for each exact operating condition remain in one split
data_audit.scope: No scores used in grouping. No claim that every statistical dependence or physical measurement identity has been established.

money_scope: Returned-usage public-price estimates, not invoices. Earlier 19 unknown fees remain unknown. Continued copies of the same provider journals count once. CPU and controller/human work are not monetized.

time_scope: Project time includes conventional initial search and final confirmation. Active time adds interrupted original work and CPU continuation, omitting the intervening operator wait; interruption-inclusive wall retains that wait. Failed initial setup is charged to its continued slot. Project sums overlap; data/harness preparation, preflight, analysis and packaging are outside project time.
